title: Mack Trident hi-tensile al FUPS Bullbar #16
description: Mack Trident hi-tensile aluminium FUPS Bullbar. 88mm dia pipe, 100mm dia available. Reversible aluminium Road Train signs. Contoured lower main channel with indicator repeater lights. One piece cross pipes passing through drilled uprights and recessed into drilled outer uprights, no but welds.
